$comment: Milestone manifest for Yolkster64/helios-platform, applied by scripts/github/apply-milestones.ps1 (GET-diff-then-apply, dry-run by default; matches by title, patches description and due date, never closes or deletes). due_on is a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD); the script sends it as noon UTC so GitHub's Pacific-midnight normalization keeps the same date. The Projects board's DueDate custom field (scripts/board-setup/setup-custom-fields.ps1) is independent and is not synced from these dates.
